scope: Protected catalogue signing and public publication infrastructure; source-only validation, not a production deployment or application release.

source.ciCheckoutExplanation: GitHub's pull-request merge ref combining the infrastructure commit with the recorded main baseline; the exact checkout is printed in the job log.

ci.countingNote: Only this successful CI job is included in the 56-test total. Overlapping local runs and prior application validation are not added. The publisher's expected refusal-to-overwrite diagnostic is part of a passing negative test, not a failed test.

validationBoundaries.newSigningAndDeploymentSuites: Use the deliberately public existing SDK RSA fixture, real local OpenSSL signing where applicable, and mocked GitHub/public-download transports.
validationBoundaries.establishedPublisherSuite: Uses ephemeral test-only RSA keys for its signing cases; no production key is created or used.
validationBoundaries.archivePreparationTests: Check the reviewed 32-pack profile and asset lock and isolated acquisition/cache cases. This CI job does not download or execute all 32 published packs.
checkedBehaviors: Missing or malformed signing prerequisites and wrong public fingerprints fail closed.
Private temporary files have restricted permissions, child processes do not inherit the key environment variable, and signing failures clean temporary material without exposing its contents.
Only the required public documents are accepted; source identity, exact hosts, signatures, reports and reviewed archive pins are verified.
Every signed historical catalogue contributes immutable pack-version pins; removed and reintroduced versions cannot change their archive identity or URL.
Malformed or conflicting signed history, stale timestamps, ref races and non-fast-forward updates are rejected.
A receipt records uncertain or completed ref writes before anonymous verification; bounded stale-download retries do not claim rollback or success.
Anonymous verification compares exact moving-URL and commit-pinned-history bytes using a mocked transport.
Authenticated API redirects are rejected and API failures do not expose tokens or response bodies.

retainedDevelopmentDiagnostics.finding: The first deployment implementation compared new pack pins only with the immediately previous catalogue.
retainedDevelopmentDiagnostics.reproduction: An in-memory test published 32 packs, removed align in a later catalogue, then restored its unchanged ID/version with a different archive SHA-256 and matching changed lock. The old code accepted the third publication.
retainedDevelopmentDiagnostics.correction: Accumulate immutable identity tuples from every signature-validated historical payload, reject inconsistent historical repetitions, and compare incoming rows with that complete map before any writes.
retainedDevelopmentDiagnostics.status: Fixed before the recorded infrastructure commit; both regressions passed in the recorded CI job. No production catalogue was affected.

retainedDevelopmentDiagnostics.finding: An initial local minimal-main integration omitted publishing/setup-catalogue.UNSIGNED.json, which the deployment tests require.
retainedDevelopmentDiagnostics.correction: Copy the unchanged public preview fixture from the recorded setup-input origin. It remains unsigned fixture data and establishes no production trust.
retainedDevelopmentDiagnostics.status: Local integration setup failed before this correction; the complete committed dependency set passed the recorded CI job.

retainedDevelopmentDiagnostics.finding: A subsequent local integration attempt ran before the copied lock/profile belonged to the named checkout commit.
retainedDevelopmentDiagnostics.correction: Test the committed infrastructure checkout. The existing source-identity guard was retained and was not weakened to accept uncommitted inputs.
retainedDevelopmentDiagnostics.status: The local attempt failed its checkout/committed-input guard; the exact committed PR merge checkout passed the recorded CI job.
